controls.name: Header: logo and "Todd's Factory"
controls.what: A name bar across the top of the screen.
controls.from: Drawn by Stitch as part of its frame. Not built (decision 0008).
notes: The board has no header of its own; the first thing on it is Needs you and the Decision support link.

controls.name: Decision support link
controls.what: A link to the Decision support view, with its arrow. One tap from the board, always visible.
controls.from: Fixed text. Opens the Map view (picture 09).
notes: It sits where the header was; if the header is not built the link still needs a place at the top (G1).

controls.name: Needs you (2): title and count
controls.what: The title of the strip of things waiting on Todd, with how many there are.
controls.from: The count of action items (the six kinds in picture 06). The machine and Linear supply them.
notes: Amber, because it is waiting on Todd. With nothing waiting, the strip shows an empty state (rule R-08).

controls.name: First action row: "Try the recipe screens (UAT)"
controls.what: One thing waiting on Todd, in plain words, with an arrow. This one is a card in UAT.
controls.from: Linear: the card's status is UAT. The wording is built from the card title.

controls.name: Second action row: "Approve 3 retro fixes"
controls.what: Another thing waiting on Todd: retro lessons awaiting his approval.
controls.from: The machine's retro output. No data exists for this yet.
notes: No screen is drawn for approving retro fixes (S-45). The row is green here and amber above; colour carries no meaning (rule R-07), so all rows look the same (G3).

controls.name: Backlog stage line (folded)
controls.what: The stage's name and how many cards are in it, on one line, with a down arrow. Folded when the screen opens. Tapping opens or folds it.
controls.from: Linear: cards whose status is Backlog, counted.
notes: What opens when Todd taps it is open (G4).

controls.name: Ready stage line (folded)
controls.what: Same as Backlog, for Ready cards. A Ready card is where Start lives.
notes: The Start button is not drawn on the board (G5).

controls.name: Implementation stage line (open)
controls.what: Stage name and count, with an up arrow. Open on load because a running card is inside it. Its count is shown in the stage's colour.
controls.from: Linear: status Implementation. Open or folded on load comes from whether a card in it is running, stuck or waiting.

controls.name: Running card row: title and down arrow
controls.what: One card inside its stage: its title, and an arrow that expands the card in place (picture 03).
controls.from: Linear: the card's title. Which card is running comes from the build machine (B-01).

controls.name: "Running" pill
controls.what: A word-and-colour label on the card: Running.
controls.from: Whether the build is active, from the build machine.
notes: The pills drawn are Running, Stuck and Waiting on you; a stopped card has "Stopped" (picture 05). What a card not running shows is open (G6).

controls.name: Evidence review stage line (folded, 0)
controls.what: A stage with no cards: its name, 0, and a down arrow.
notes: Folded because nothing running, stuck or waiting is in it.

controls.name: Remediation stage line (open)
controls.what: Stage name and count, open because a stuck card is inside it. Rose because of the stuck card.
controls.from: Linear: status Remediation. Open and the colour come from the card inside being stuck.
notes: If Todd folds a stage that holds a stuck card, nothing shows it is stuck (G7).

controls.name: Stuck card row: title and down arrow
controls.what: A card in its stage with a rose border, so it stands out.
controls.from: Linear title; stuck comes from the build machine (no activity for 5 minutes).

controls.name: "Stuck" pill
controls.what: Rose pill with the word Stuck.
controls.from: The build machine: 5 minutes with no activity (glossary "Stuck").
notes: The picture has no icon; the story needs one with the word (status is never colour alone, rule R-05).

controls.name: UAT stage line (open)
controls.what: Stage name and count, amber, open because a card is waiting on Todd.

controls.name: UAT card row: title and down arrow
controls.what: A card waiting for Todd to try it. The title wraps to two lines rather than being cut off.
controls.from: Linear: card title and its status UAT.
notes: What it shows when tapped is open (G8). Labels are never cut off (rule R-06).

controls.name: "Waiting on you" pill
controls.what: Amber pill with the words Waiting on you.
controls.from: The card is in UAT, or a build is waiting on his answer (B-08).

controls.name: Complete stage line (folded, 12)
controls.from: Linear: status Complete. The cards stay until their project is Completed (S-07).

gaps.text: The header is not built, but the Decision support link has to sit somewhere.
gaps.res: Closed (Todd, 27 Oct): the link stays top right on its own line, with the plain-text title "Factory" beside it.

gaps.text: Tapping an action row: does it open that item's action directly, or the Needs you list (picture 06)?
gaps.res: Closed: a row opens that item's action; the "Needs you" title opens the full list.

gaps.text: How many rows the strip shows when more than two things are waiting. Picture 02 shows one amber and one green row.
gaps.res: Closed: up to three rows, all the same colour, then "See all (n)" opens the list.

gaps.text: What opens when Todd taps Backlog (30) or Complete (12): how many cards are listed and in what order.
gaps.res: Closed: most recently moved first, five at a time with "Show more". Start with this and change it if it doesn't work.

gaps.text: The Start button on a Ready card is not drawn on the board.
gaps.res: Closed: an open Ready card shows Start, which opens the Start screen.

gaps.text: The pill on cards that aren't running (Backlog, Ready, Staging, Complete).
gaps.res: Closed: no pill on cards that aren't running. Pills only for Running, Stuck, Waiting on you and Stopped.

gaps.text: A folded stage hides a stuck or waiting card inside it.
gaps.res: Closed: Stuck pulses (pill and icon, and the stage line holding it, folded or open). Waiting on you is a steady amber mark with its icon. With reduced motion set, the pulse becomes a static, bolder rose header and icon.

gaps.text: What a tapped card shows when it is not running: Backlog, Ready, UAT, Staging, Complete.
gaps.res: Closed: every card shows title, status and a Linear link. Ready adds Start, UAT adds a link to try it, Complete adds a link to its card page.
